notes.subject: את
notes.rationale: sampela ol man i tok se ⟨את⟩ i stap namel long רצית יהוה, tasol mi putim ⟨את⟩ long graun bilong yu olsem wanpela mak bilong wanem samting i kisim wok

notes.subject: shevut
notes.rationale: shavut i min olgeta exil o stat bilong bipo we i kamap bek; 'kalabus i kam bek' o 'ol i go bek long ples bilong bipo'

translation: Yahwe, yu save laikim ⟨את⟩ graun bilong yu, yu senisim ⟨את⟩ ol we i go long kalabus bilong Yakov i kam bek.

tokens.gloss: ol we i go long kalabus
